subject: Clarify PO identifier, invoice rail and early-pay discount
messages:
From: Lori Smith <lori.smith@palmerhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@palmerhealth.com
Date: 2026-09-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PO format question + early-pay option

Hi Karthik,

Quick procurement question before we send the formal PO: our AP team prefers a single PO that references multiple subscriptions on separate lines (one PO = one billing entity). Will Redwood accept that format, or do you require separate POs per subscription? Also, our finance team is asking whether Redwood would entertain an early-pay discount if we pay faster than your standard terms — our initial ask is 1.5% if payment is made within 15 days.

If possible, could you confirm the minimum PO fields you need (PO number format, remit address, tax/VAT id, billing entity name)? I attached our PO template for reference (PO_template.xlsx).

Thanks — I want to get the paperwork right so legal and AP can move quickly.

Cheers,
Lori Smith
Sr. Procurement Manager | Palmer Health

+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: PO_template.xlsx

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO format question + early-pay option

Hi Lori — thanks for sending this over and for attaching the template. Short answers up front: we can usually accept a single PO with multiple line items as long as the PO includes a master PO number and clearly lists the billing entity and remit instructions.

Couple of clarifying asks so I can loop in finance and sales ops:
- Confirm desired payment terms (you wrote early-pay within 15 days with 1.5% discount — is that in lieu of Net45 or on top of it?)
- Which billing cadence do you prefer: monthly consolidated invoice (one invoice for the PO with line-item detail) or weekly statements?
- Please confirm the exact bill-to entity name and the tax/VAT number you expect on the invoice.

I copied Vanessa and Ben to confirm discount policy and final PO acceptance checklist. Once we agree, Ben will provide a PO acceptance template that lists the required fields to ensure AP can match invoices automatically.

Happy to jump on a quick call if that speeds things up.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO format question + early-pay option

Karthik — forwarding Lori's ask and adding internal notes. Quoting Lori below for context.

> our AP team prefers a single PO that references multiple subscriptions on separate lines (one PO = one billing entity).
> would Redwood accept that format, or do you require separate POs per subscription?

Operational proposal from Sales Ops: we are OK to accept a single PO with multiple subscriptions provided the PO includes the following as discrete fields: master PO number, remit-to address, billing entity legal name, billing contact email, tax/VAT ID, and a line indicating desired invoice cadence (monthly vs weekly). If the PO does not include those, AP matching can fail and delay payment.

On the discount ask: we typically offer negotiated early-pay discounts for enterprise deals but the percentage and eligibility depend on a few things: whether the PO is a blanket/master agreement, whether invoices are consolidated monthly, and whether finance can automate the early-pay process (we prefer 1% for Net15-style early pay on standard deals; 1.5% would need leadership approval).

Ben — can you confirm the minimum PO field set and whether finance is willing to accept 1.5% on a Net15 payment? If not, is 1% acceptable as a standard concession if they consolidate invoices monthly?

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: SOW.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lori Smith <lori.smith@palmerhealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO format question + early-pay option

Hi Lori — thanks for the clear ask and for the template. Finance has reviewed; here is the PO acceptance checklist and our position on the early-pay concession.

Required PO fields (PO must include all of the following):
- PO number (alphanumeric, up to 32 chars)
- Bill-to legal entity name (must match invoicing entity on our side)
- Remit address and remittance email (for AP)
- Tax / VAT ID (if applicable)
- Billing contact name & email for invoice questions
- Invoice cadence: specify "Monthly Consolidated Invoice" or "Weekly Statement"

Invoice matching notes: we will only auto-match invoices to a PO if the PO number and bill-to entity are exact matches. If the PO places multiple subscriptions under one line without line-item detail, our AP team will request additional detail which can delay payment.

Early-pay discount: we can offer a 1% discount if full payment is received within 15 days of invoice date, provided invoices are consolidated monthly and the PO is issued as a master/blanket PO. The 1.5% rate requires approval from CFO for this account and is possible for very large committed spend; we need the PO value and committed volume for that escalation.

Next steps:
1) If you can send an updated PO with the required fields, we will confirm acceptance within 24 business hours.
2) If you want to pursue 1.5%, please provide the expected 12-month committed spend and we'll route to finance leadership.

Attached: PO_acceptance_template.pdf (shows exact field formatting we need).

Regards,
Ben Carter
Director, Billing & Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0122
Attachment: PO_acceptance_template.pdf
From: Lori Smith <lori.smith@palmerhealth.com>

Date: 2026-09-16T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO format question + early-pay option

Ben / team — thanks, this is exactly what AP needs. We will:
- Issue a master PO with multiple line items that include line-level subscription IDs and unit prices.
- Populate the PO with the bill-to legal name and Palmer Health tax ID.
- Choose "Monthly Consolidated Invoice" cadence.

We are happy to take the 1% early-pay discount if it applies to consolidated monthly invoices paid within 15 days. We will also include the expected 12-month commit on the PO so you can evaluate the 1.5% escalation if the CFO needs that data.

I'll have legal / AP circulate the updated PO by tomorrow. Once you confirm receipt, we'll switch the billing contact to procurement@palmerhealth.com for ease of matching.

Thanks — Lori
Lori Smith
Sr. Procurement Manager | Palmer Health
